title: Zesty Winey Norwegian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Norwegian lamb stew featuring pomegranate and a blend of Mediterranean spices, cooked to perfection in an agave leaf vessel. This dish is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion until it is translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb cubes to the pan and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the red wine, pomegranate juice, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Transfer the stew to an agave leaf vessel and cook in the preheated oven for 2 hours.
Stir in the pomegranate seeds and continue to cook for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the stew from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
